rationale: The agent executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming details and obtaining explicit user approval, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. It also stated that a $16.85 difference would be charged to the user's PayPal account without prior confirmation of payment method. While it looked up the user by email and fetched order details, there was no explicit user authentication step shown beyond matching the provided email. Additionally, the stated price difference is not supported by any visible tool output in the transcript. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass criteria.
